Thakur  Mr. Rishabh Tayal  Mr. Jitendra Choudhary  Mr. Muskan Jangid  Mr. Vivek Sharma For Respondent(s) : Mr. Prem Singh Panwar, PP  Mr. Naresh Singh for complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 11/11/2024 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.36/2023 registered at Police Station Prasad,
Dist. Udaipur, for the offences under Sections 420 and 120-B of IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that as per the prosecution, the petitioner Rajendra Kalal is son of one Shri Dalchand Kalal who is a mortgagee of the disputed property.

The petitioner despite having full knowledge that he is not the real owner of the property got the lease-deed and patta executed and issued in his favor, merely on the basis of uninterrupted possession.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the [2024:RJ-JD:45414] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-12527/2024]
offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioner are triable by Court of Magistrate.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the bail application.

Learned counsel for the complainant submitted that in the present case, the petitioner has committed cheating with the complainant of his valuable property having full knowledge that he was not the owner of the same.
It was thus prayed that looking to the seriousness of the accusations against the present petitioner, he does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.
Heard learned counsel for the parties at Bar.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court prima facie finds that the investigation against the petitioner has already been completed and the offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioner are triable by Court of Magistrate.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Rajendra [2024:RJ-JD:45414] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-12527/2024] Kalal S/o Dalchand Kalal arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.36/2023 registered at Police Station Prasad,
Dist. Udaipur, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 52-divya/-
